title: Shinonome Ena — Mystery Tour Baptism?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few days after the trip

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That look on Mizuki's face on the train back. I wasn't just seeing things, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan. I looked at the sketches you sent me earlier. I like the overall design, but this person's expression seems...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh?! Oh, K. Sorry!
Don't worry, I heard what you said.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Uh oh. Was Enanan taking a little nap...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, K, I wasn't happy with how this person's expression came out, so I'll try to come up with something a little better...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Send it again once you're done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, I think I got everything that I wanted to do finished... I'm logging off now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But was what I saw on the train real...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? You're up already? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's about Mizuki.
Have you noticed anything strange lately?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: With Akiyama...? I wouldn't know since we might go days without seeing each other.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But last time...
Oh, I was asked to wake you up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, Akiyama's never at school to begin with so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not really... Aren't you gonna be late?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What? You stopped me...
Nevermind, I'm going...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's true that Mizuki hardly ever goes to school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And you actually woke up!
Good for you♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course I did. I'm the one that invited you here. Just who do you and Akito think I am, honestly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I don't know what your li'l bro told you, but it just seems natural to say, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyways, you wanted to do some shopping?
What's on today's menu?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Summer clothes. Some places usually start selling stuff early so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, nice! I was just thinking that it's about time they did too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm, another botanical pattern? The other store had this too. Is this what's gonna be in this year?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Dunno. It might sell a little, but I doubt something like this'll catch on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the dull-colored ones made of satin were pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I have to agree.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey! That looks nice too!
Let's take a look!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I think I went a little overboard...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But we found some really cute stuff, so it's all good♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Maybe I was wrong...
But I'm still not sure...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Wanna take a little detour before we split?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The crepe place by that one store we went to♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Apparently, they have this limited-edition spring strawberry crepe with real strawberries mixed into the crepe itself. It's all pink and super cute!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! I need to see this!
